messages:
ryan: quick note: saw a flakey 401 during quickstart when using redwoodctl local serve after running the macOS pkg installer
ryan: env flow was: export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk_test_abc && redwoodctl local init --profile quickstart && redwoodctl local serve --profile quickstart
ryan: sometimes the runtime starts but immediately logs: WARN profile "quickstart" token empty
ryan: requests then get 401s even though REDWOOD_API_KEY is set
tasha: do you have the logs from DEBUG? we need to see resolver decisions
ryan: pasted debug snippet:
ryan: ```
DEBUG config files checked: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/.redwood/config -> /Users/ryan/.redwood/config -> /etc/redwood/config
DEBUG found /Users/ryan/.redwood/config
DEBUG profile quickstart token: ""
DEBUG env REDWOOD_API_KEY present
DEBUG final token: ""
``` 
luis: looks like CLI is picking the file even when token is empty. that's our old precedence bug but with a race attached
tasha: any idea why file is empty? the installer writes a skeleton profile during postinstall and our local init sometimes reads it before env lookup
ryan: repro is timing-sensitive. if I remove ~/.redwood/config before init it works every time
infra-bot: Created issue #6123: local CLI treats empty profile token as authoritative; postinstall race produces empty config (https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwoodctl/issues/6123) :robot_face:
luis: proposed fixes: 1) resolve precedence to prefer non-empty REDWOOD_API_KEY over empty file; 2) treat empty token as absent and continue searching; 3) installer should not create user profiles during packaging
tasha: agree. small UX change: when file token is empty, print hint: "found empty token in /path; if you intended to use REDWOOD_API_KEY ensure it's set in this shell or run redwoodctl auth login"
ryan: temporary workaround for folks: rm -f ~/.redwood/config && rerun init, or run `redwoodctl auth login` explicitly
luis: i'll take the resolver patch. tasha can update the installer docs to avoid precreating files
devex-bot: Noted. Adding to quickstart FAQ and bumping onboarding priority. Issue #6123 linked to onboarding docs
ryan: thanks team — workaround unblocked my demo. will test the PR when it's ready
